svg.title: The same 64 GPUs of small jobs, spread and packed (S06)
svg.text: SPREAD (LeastAllocated): no node whole, the 4 x 8 gang cannot start
PACKED (MostAllocated): 8 whole nodes, the gang starts
Purple: a GPU held by a small job. The layout is the one recorded in the dev run; the final run's numbers are in S06.
